meta.name: Norway and Denmark
meta.note: Approximate reconstruction. Weserubung was a coastal landing, not a moving front: German control spreads from the ports inland and up the coast, and the Allied lodgement at Narvik is taken and then given up when France collapses.

keyframes.label: Weserubung. Denmark falls in a day; six Norwegian ports are seized at dawn.
The landings link up. The Germans push north from Oslo up the Gudbrandsdal.
Southern Norway is given up. The Allies evacuate Andalsnes and Namsos.
Narvik is retaken by the Allies — the first Allied ground victory of the war.
Norway capitulates. With France collapsing, the Allies sail away and leave it.
